scenes.heading: Affiliate Networks Explained — ShareASale, Impact, CJ, and More

sents.d: Affiliate Networks Explained — ShareASale, Impact, CJ, and More
How affiliate networks work, which ones to join, and how to navigate their dashboards.
An affiliate network is a middleman between you and hundreds (or thousands) of companies.
Instead of applying to each company individually, you join one network and access many programs.
The network handles tracking, reporting, and payments.
You get one dashboard instead of twenty.
ShareASale: Huge variety, beginner-friendly, tons of small-to-medium brands.
Best for bloggers and content creators.
CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction): Big-name brands (GoPro, Overstock, Priceline).
Higher approval standards.
Impact: Tech-forward, great dashboard, growing fast (Shopify, Uber, Airbnb).
ClickBank: Digital products and courses, higher commissions (20-75%), but quality varies widely — vet products carefully.
Networks want to see: a real website or active social media profile, a clear content strategy, some existing audience (even small).
Write a thoughtful application — don't just say "I want to make money." Explain your niche, your audience, and how you plan to promote products.
Some programs auto-approve; others review manually and may take days.
Key metrics to track: clicks (how many people click your links), conversion rate (what percentage of clicks become sales), EPC (earnings per click — the most important number), and commission amount.
Check your dashboard weekly.
Look for which products and content pieces drive the most revenue, then double down on what works.
Apply to programs that match your niche specifically — don't just grab every program available.
Negotiate higher rates after you prove you can drive sales (most programs will increase rates for top affiliates).
Use deep links (links to specific product pages, not just homepages).
Check for seasonal promotions and increased commission events.
Some networks offer bonuses for hitting volume thresholds.

take: Networks give access to many brands from one dashboard.
